result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall: header, search, category chips, promo banner, and restaurant cards all align correctly. No critical or major visual defects found. Only minor polish suggestions noted.

issues.description: The red notification dot on the top-right profile avatar has no accompanying label or badge count, so its meaning is unclear
issues.suggestion: Ensure the red badge has an accessible label or a screen describing what the notification refers to

issues.description: The first carousel card (Green Bowl Poké) shows a delivery-time badge but lacks the heart/favorite button that other cards include, creating slight inconsistency in card anatomy
issues.suggestion: Standardize badge style across similar elements or omit the badge where no promo applies
